note: Values the app needs that the Design System does not define yet, used by more than one widget. Values are carried over unchanged from the old foundations. The owner moves them into the Design System; then they leave this file.

tokens.name: sizeChip
tokens.usage: Chip and filter chip height, as the Material 3 chip container. A chip never wraps, its row scrolls.

tokens.name: sizeFab
tokens.usage: Floating action button, square, icon only, as the Material 3 FAB container.

tokens.name: sizeIconInline
tokens.usage: Icon inside body text; the smallest icon.

tokens.name: sizeIconButton
tokens.usage: The leading glyph of a button, as the Material 3 button icon size; its gap to the label is space8.

tokens.name: sizeSelectionControl
tokens.usage: The radio ring and the checkbox box, as the Material 3 selection controls (Checkbox.width; the radio ring is stroked at the centre of a 16 circle).

tokens.name: sizeRadioDot
tokens.usage: The selected radio dot, as the Material 3 inner radius of 4.5.

tokens.name: radiusCheckbox
tokens.usage: The checkbox corner, as the Material 3 checkbox shape.

tokens.name: strokeFocusGap
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring (tokens.json: focus ring in primary, offset 2px). Buttons and the FAB draw an offset ring.

tokens.name: strokeControl
tokens.usage: Unselected radio ring and checkbox border.

tokens.name: strokeIndicator
tokens.usage: Spinner arc and other progress strokes.

tokens.name: opacityMuted
tokens.usage: Readable content that steps back: an answered choice out of play, a footer caption.

tokens.name: opacityScrim
tokens.usage: Alpha of the scrim behind a dialog or a bottom sheet. The value from before the Indigo palette: Indigo raised it together with its tinted scrim colour, and the Design System replaced both (ADR-022).
